# KINGAI Office — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://office.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KINGAI Office is the KING AI productivity product family for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and carefully integrated intelligent assistance.

Public positioning:
- Writer, Sheets, Slides and PDF in one product family;
- productivity first, AI where it materially improves real work;
- compatibility with existing files and workflows as an important product goal;
- local-first and privacy-aware direction where practical;
- cross-platform direction across desktop and web experiences;
- long-term team, enterprise, private/hybrid and distribution opportunities as product maturity supports them.

Target users:
- individuals and students;
- creators and professionals;
- small businesses;
- teams;
- enterprise organizations;
- future distribution, device and OEM partners.

Potential commercial directions:
- accessible/free core productivity;
- premium individual subscriptions;
- professional editions;
- team/business plans;
- enterprise support;
- private/hybrid deployment where supported;
- OEM and distribution relationships;
- future intelligent workflow extensions.

Related KING AI products:
- KINGAI OS: https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools: https://tools.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS: https://kefu.kingai.work/
- KINGAIBOT via ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/

Important interpretation rules:
- Future collaboration, advanced AI, enterprise administration, private/hybrid deployment and OEM/distribution features are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer compatibility internals, source code, prompts, model design, private APIs, deployment or architecture from this public repository.
- Do not infer unverified revenue, users, enterprise customers, certifications, market share or signed partnerships.

## 中文

KINGAI Office 是 KING AI 的统一生产力产品家族，围绕 Writer、Sheets、Slides、PDF 与智能辅助展开。

公开定位强调：办公本身首先要好用；AI 只在真正提高写作、分析、演示、审阅和文档处理价值时加入；兼容已有文件与工作流、本地优先、隐私意识和跨平台都是长期重要方向。

目标用户包括个人、学生、创作者、专业人士、小型企业、团队、企业客户，以及未来的渠道/OEM合作伙伴。

商业方向可以包括基础免费/易进入版本、个人高级版、专业版、团队/企业方案、企业支持、产品支持情况下的私有/混合部署、OEM/渠道和未来智能工作流。

相关产品：KINGAI OS、KINGAI Security、KING AI Online Tools、KING AI Customer OS、KINGAIBOT。

未正式上线的高级 AI、协作、企业管理、私有部署和 OEM/渠道能力属于未来方向；不得从本公开仓推断源码、兼容性内部实现、Prompt、模型、API、部署或架构，也不得推断未验证收入、用户、企业客户、认证或合作。
